dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: Feast your eyes on the gorgeous fur of the Alpacas, born and bred in Natlan! It's super soft, wonderfully warm, and perfect for making clothes or carpets alike!

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: Ah, now here's a person of fine tastes! These are all from Natlan, and so are the Alpacas. Phlogiston-rich environments make their fur even warmer and fluffier!

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: That said, whether it be clothes or even the Masters of the Night-Wind's woven scrolls, we don't really use these fluffy furs in Natlan. They're much more popular in cold places like this!

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: Hmm... And I brought the Alpacas along because...

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: My tribe elders said, "Alpacas will grow more fur to keep warm in cold climates"... or something like that, so I'm trying to see if it's true.

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: Hehe, anyway, Natlanese anything is the best, even when we're not in Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are those furs really from Natlan...?

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: Of course! Haha, I saw these being transported all the way with my own two eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: I'm not like those folks who only have money on their minds. I'm selling Natlanese Alpaca furs here — these furs are the pride of Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: And there's no way I'll tarnish my nation's reputation when it comes to the quality of my furs!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye, and good luck with everything.
